hook: Card skimmers hid inside Black Friday shopping.

beats.say: A skimming script was planted on the stores of Lascana, Samsonite, American Tourister, Revolve and FWRD in the week before Black Friday.
It stole card numbers, expiry dates and security codes, then sent them out over a WebRTC data channel, outside the browser's usual request controls.
All five sites removed the script by November twenty-fourth or twenty-fifth, after researchers reported it to them.
